title: Senior Backend Engineer - Earth Observation Platform (EUP)
description:
Back to jobs New Senior Backend Engineer - Earth Observation Platform (EUP) Berlin | Hybrid; Munich | Hybrid Apply Job description Team & Reporting Line: Data Platforms Lead | Data & Analytics Our Mission At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth - where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions. From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world. Your Role We are building the next generation of thermal satellites. This is not a concept on a slide: our first two SkyBee satellites have been in orbit since 2025, each flying a cryocooled thermal infrared instrument on a microsatellite, and, backed by a €37M Series A, our next satellites are already in the pipeline. But none of it matters until the data reaches a customer. That’s where you come in. In Data & Analytics, we are building the team that will turn this data into AI-powered intelligence products across all customer segments: for defence and security customers in National Security and Maritime Awareness; for public-sector customers in Urban Dynamics and Food & Water Security; and for commercial customers in Industrial Monitoring, delivered directly and through partner platforms. Beyond that, we are laying the groundwork for multi-domain intelligence integration, for example as part of a European sovereign space intelligence consortium. Join constellr’s Earth Observation Platform (EUP) team and build the backend that turns satellite data into a reliable, accessible product. You will develop the customer-facing backbone through which users discover, order, purchase and access our data, connecting a growing Earth observation archive with customer accounts, entitlements, payments, order and delivery state. Working closely with Product, Data Platform, frontend engineering, processing and quality-control teams, you will build robust workflows for commercial customers and scalable access for open-data programmes. Your work will directly shape how customers interact with our data, from finding the right product and placing an order to tracking its status and receiving the data they are entitled to use. Key responsibilities Design, build and operate backend services and APIs for the End User Platform, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability and clear service ownership. Own and evolve order lifecycle and delivery-state workflows, including status transitions, retries, idempotency, reconciliation, auditability and integration with processing and quality-control systems. Design and maintain relational data models for users, organisations, orders, entitlements, archive access and related platform state. Integrate payment and commercial services, including payment-provider webhooks, subscriptions or credits, usage accounting and the backend workflows needed to support commercial data access. Build authentication, authorisation and entitlement mechanisms for users, organisations and datasets, supporting both commercial and open-data access models. Develop scalable search and archive-access services around STAC, object storage and geospatial APIs, enabling customers to discover and retrieve constellr data through web and programmatic interfaces. Support open-data programmes with public API access, rate limiting, licensing/attribution controls and scalable download or delivery mechanisms. Define observability, monitoring and operational practices for EUP backend services and contribute to architecture, security and production-readiness reviews across Data Platforms. Collaborate closely with Product and frontend engineers to translate customer journeys into clean backend contracts, while coordinating with data platform and other internal services. Job requirements About you Required: Strong professional experience (5+ years) building and operating production backend services, preferably in Python with FastAPI or comparable frameworks. Strong relational DBMS experience, including schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing and performance optimisation. Experience designing APIs and distributed workflows where correctness matters, including asynchronous processing, state machines, retries, idempotency and failure recovery. Experience with authentication and authorisation patterns such as OAuth2/OIDC, role- or entitlement-based access, and multi-user or multi-tenant SaaS systems. Hands-on experience integrating external services and webhooks; comfortable working with payment, billing, subscription or usage-metering concepts. Working knowledge of cloud-native delivery practices such as Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring and structured logging. Ability to work autonomously across product requirements and technical architecture, communicate trade-offs clearly and take ownership of production systems. Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, debugging and documentation, while maintaining ownership of architecture, correctness, security and production quality. Nice to Have : Experience with geospatial systems, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, STAC, COGs, S3/object storage or Earth observation data platforms. Experience building developer-facing or data-access SaaS products, marketplaces, open-data portals or high-volume download/delivery systems. Experience with Stripe or comparable payment platforms and commercial entitlement models. Familiarity with event-driven architectures, message brokers and Kubernetes-based platforms. Why join constellr? High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies. Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match. Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers. Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy. Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.
